svg.text: Enterprise Field Service Management (Salesforce FSL / Dynamics 365 / ServiceMax) Dispatch & Tech Voice AI
Van-Stock Part & Skill Lock (91.8% First-Time Fix) · T-60m Access Confirm (-82.5% Wasted Trips) · 0ms Gas/ICU SLA Preemption
FIELD-SERVICE-FSL-DISPATCH-01
1. Multimodal Pre-Triage & FSM Core
Salesforce Field Service · Dynamics 365 FS · ServiceMax
Pre-Dispatch WebRTC Nameplate & Fault Triage
• Scans equipment serial/error code (`Err-E4`) on call
• Predicts required replacement SKU (`Compressor_Valve_B`)
Predicted_Part_SKU = "PART-8841" (Confidence = 96.4%)
Van-Stock Inventory & Skill Matrix Engine
• Matches tech van trunk stock (`Van_#42 Has PART-8841`)
• Verifies active license (`EPA_608_Universal / HV_Cert`)
Tech_Match = "Tech_#109 (14m Away | Van_Stock = 2)"
T-60m Customer ETA & Access Gate Call
• Calls customer 60m prior to confirm adult present
• Captures gate code, loading-dock clearance & pet lock
Site_Access_Confirmed = True | Gate_Code = "#4409"
Hands-Free Technician Voice debrief & Closeout
• Tech dictates root cause, parts used & warranty status
• Auto-populates ServiceMax / D365 work-order Debrief
Tech_Admin_Time_Saved = -42 Minutes / Day / Tech
2. Deterministic Van-Stock, Access & SLA Gate
91.8% First-Time Fix · -82.5% No-Access Trips · 0ms Hazard
Gate A: Van-Stock Part & Tech Certification Hard Lock
• Blocks dispatching a technician without the required
replacement SKU in their van or expired safety cert
• Enforces warranty entitlement check before fee quote
First_Time_Fix_Rate_FTFR = 91.8% (vs 71.0% Legacy)
Uncertified_High_Voltage_Dispatch = 0.0%
Gate B: T-60m Access Confirm & 15s Slot Backfill Gate
• Holds technician departure until customer confirms
site presence at T-60m; if rescheduled, auto-calls
nearby waitlist customer to backfill slot in 15s
No_Access_Wasted_Truck_Roll_Reduction = -82.5%
Same_Day_Canceled_Slot_Backfill_Rate = 88.2%
Gate C: 0ms Gas/CO Leak, Entrapment & Hospital P1
• Detects natural gas odor, carbon monoxide alarm,
passenger elevator entrapment, or hospital ICU/MRI down
• Preempts routine schedule in 0ms; dispatches nearest
emergency crew & bridges master safety dispatcher
if (gasLeakEntrapmentOrHospitalP1Down) -> 0ms Emergency
P99_Gate_Latency = 12ms | P1_SLA_Compliance = 99.9%
3. Fleet Utilization & First-Time Fix ROI
+1.4 Completed Jobs/Tech/Day · Zero Repeat Visits
+20.8% Lift in First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR)
• Eliminates "Tech arrives, diagnoses part X, orders part,
returns 5 days later" double truck-roll waste
• Saves $185 per avoided repeat technician visit
Repeat_Visit_Elimination = -71.7% Fewer 2nd Visits
Hands-Free In-Van Voice Work-Order Debrief
• Tech speaks 30s debrief while walking back to van;
AI maps serials, labor codes & customer invoice PDF
• Frees 42m/day per tech (+1.4 extra billable jobs/day)
Billable_Jobs_Per_Tech_Day = 6.2 (vs 4.8 Manual)
Benchmark & TCO Summary (10k Field Work Orders)
• Legacy Dispatch + Repeat Visits: $542,000 / 10k jobs
• FSL/D365 Guarded Voice AI: $148,500 / 10k jobs (Rec)
• Basic Calendar Bot: $390,000 (blind to van stock)
Net_Field_Ops_Savings = -$393,500 / 10k Work Orders
FTFR = 91.8% | No_Access_Waste = 1.4%

Cloud & AI Solution Architect Takeaway — Enterprise Field Service Management Voice AI
Verify replacement part SKU in van stock via multimodal pre-triage before dispatch, and confirm customer access at T-60m.
